compute_map_mAP: compute mean average precision from a submission array and ground truth array for action recognition
compute_map_weighted: compute weighted mean average precision using class frequencies from ground truth labels
charades_map_evaluate: evaluate Charades action recognition predictions using the approximate mAP evaluation function
charades_map_empty_videos: handle empty ground truth videos by masking submissions before computing mAP
create_submission_file: create a submission file from video IDs and prediction arrays for Charades evaluation
